items.name: _transaction_s_assignedTo_t
items.description: The business entity this transaction is assigned to for review.

items.name: _transaction_s_transactionSource_t
items.description: The business entity that initiated this transaction.

items.name: _transaction_s_customerStatus_t
items.description: The status of transaction for customer/buyer persona.

items.name: _transaction_s_customerVisibilityIdentifier_t
items.description: The identifier to determine fields that should be visible for customer/buyer persona.

items.name: _transaction_s_isPublished_t
items.description: Indicated whether this quote was published to customer. This flag is set to true when the quote is published for the first time.

items.name: _transaction_s_hostCompanyFullName_t
items.description: Full company name of current user's company.

items.name: _transaction_s_billToCustomerAccountID_t
items.description: TCA account integration provides value from BillingAccountId to this field based on Customer Id and Business Unit ID

items.name: _transaction_s_billToCustomerAccountName_t
items.description: TCA account integration provides value from BillingAccountName to this field based on Customer Id and Business Unit ID

items.name: _transaction_s_soldToPartyName_t
items.description: TCA account integration provides value from PartyName to this field based on Customer Id and Business Unit ID

items.name: _transaction_s_accountIntegrationResponse_t
items.description: Holds the response of TCA account integration.

items.name: _transaction_s_billTo_t_first_name
items.description: First Name of the contact person for the organization to which this order will be billed.

items.name: _transaction_s_billTo_t_last_name
items.description: Last Name of the contact person for the organization to which this order will be billed.

items.name: _transaction_s_billTo_t_company_name
items.description: Company Name of the organization where this transaction will be billed.

items.name: _transaction_s_billTo_t_company_name_2
items.description: Secondary Company Name of the organization where this transaction will be billed.

items.name: _transaction_s_billTo_t_address
items.description: First Line of the Address of the organization where this transaction will be billed.

items.name: _transaction_s_billTo_t_address_2
items.description: Second Line of the Address of the organization where this transaction will be billed.

items.name: _transaction_s_billTo_t_city
items.description: City of the organization where this transaction will be billed.

items.name: _transaction_s_billTo_t_state
items.description: State or Province of the organization where this transaction will be billed.

items.name: _transaction_s_billTo_t_zip
items.description: Zip Code of the organization where this transaction will be billed.

items.name: _transaction_s_billTo_t_country
items.description: Country of the organization where this transaction will be billed.

items.name: _transaction_s_billTo_t_phone
items.description: Phone Number for the contact person for the organization to which this order will be billed.

items.name: _transaction_s_billTo_t_fax
items.description: Fax Number for the contact person for the organization to which this order will be billed.

items.name: _transaction_s_billTo_t_email
items.description: Email Address for the contact person for the organization to which this order will be billed.

items.name: _transaction_s_skipSellerReview_t
items.description: The flag to identify if seller or sales rep should be involved in the Quote flows. This flag can be set to true if seller's involvement is not desired.

items.name: _transaction_freezePrice
items.description: Determines whether the CPQ Pricing should be invoked or not. If set to true, CPQ will not price the products/quote lines and will uses the pricing provided by external system.

items.name: _transaction_stage
items.description: Current Stage of transaction

items.name: _transaction_s_quoteForAgreement_t
items.description: Indicates whether the transaction is used as a Sales Agreement

items.name: _transaction_s_useTransactionForAnalytics_t
items.description: This is used as a filter attribute for analytics. When set to True, values in this transaction will be used by analytics.

items.name: _transaction_s_priceScoreMarginBased_t
items.description:
Price score for the transaction using Margin Based calculation method.
In order to see a value in this, please add some lines and set the 'Line Item Grid Columns' to 'PriceScoreSet'.

items.name: _transaction_s_priceScoreListBased_t
items.description: Price score for the transaction using List Based calculation method. In order to see a value in this, please add some lines and set the 'Line Item Grid Columns' to 'PriceScoreSet'.

items.name: _transaction_s_priceScoreSimpleMarginListPrice_t
items.description: Price score calculation using Simple Margin Based method and List Price as Basis attribute. In order to see a value in this, please add some lines and set the 'Line Item Grid Columns' to 'PriceScoreSet'.
items.displayLabel: Price Score Simple Margin Based (List Price Basis)

items.name: _transaction_s_priceScoreSimpleMarginNetPrice_t
items.description: Price score calculation using Simple Margin Based method and Net Price as Basis attribute. In order to see a value in this, please add some lines and set the 'Line Item Grid Columns' to 'PriceScoreSet'.
items.displayLabel: Price Score Simple Margin Based (Net Price Basis)

items.name: _transaction_s_priceScoreSimpleMarginUnitCost_t
items.description: Price score calculation using Simple Margin Based method and Unit Cost as Basis attribute. In order to see a value in this, please add some lines and set the 'Line Item Grid Columns' to 'PriceScoreSet'.
items.displayLabel: Price Score Simple Margin Based (Unit Cost Basis)

items.name: _transaction_s_winProbRevPrediction_t
items.description: Win Probability Net Revenue Value Predicted by the Price Optimization Analytic 'Optimized Discount%'.
items.displayLabel: Win Probability Net Revenue Value Prediction

items.name: _transaction_s_optimalPrimaryDriver_t
items.description: Optimal Discount% returned from Price Optimization analytic 'Optimized Discount%'.

items.name: _transaction_s_optimalWinProbability_t
items.description: Optimal Win Probability value returned from price optimization analytic 'Optimized Discount%'.

items.name: _transaction_s_optimalTargetValue_t
items.description: Optimal Target Value returned from the Price Optimization based analytic 'Optimized Discount%'.

items.name: _transaction_s_winProbability_t
items.description: Win Probability value returned from the WP analytic named 'Win Probability'.

items.name: _transaction_s_discountGuidanceFloor_t
items.description: Lower bound of the discount guidance.

items.name: _transaction_s_discountGuidanceCeiling_t
items.description: Upper bound of the discount guidance.

items.name: _transaction_s_discountGuidanceMax_t
items.description: Max of the discount guidance.

items.name: _transaction_s_isEsignatureEnabled_t
items.description: Indicates if E-signature flow (or Docusign integration) is opted for a quote.

items.name: _transaction_s_checkoutAccessEnabled_t
items.description: The entities who have access to create an order on the commerce

items.name: _transaction_s_proratedOrderLevelDiscount_t
items.description: The promotional discount (amount) provided on the total order value of the current transaction. For example, Self Service Cart level promotion of 10% on cart value of 1000$ or more.

items.name: _transaction_txnRef_bookedOrderId_t
items.description: BS_Id of the CPQ Order Transaction generated from the current quote, when order is placed from a different channel. For e.g. Quote is requested/shared between buyer and seller through self-service channel, and the order submission happened from the self service Cart by the buyer.

items.name: _transaction_txnRef_sourceQuoteId_t
items.description: Bs_id of the CPQ source quote linked to the CPQ order transaction.

items.name: _transaction_txnRef_externalSourceOrderId_t
items.description: Reference Order Id from the external system which was used to book the order.

items.name: _transaction_txnRef_primarySourceSystem_t
items.description: Primary Source System for the current transaction (Quote/Order).

items.name: _transaction_tax_isTaxPresent_t
items.description: Flag to identify if the tax information is present.

items.name: _transaction_tax_isTaxInclusive_t
items.description: Flag to identify whether taxes are calculated in the prices or not.

items.name: _transaction_tax_taxAmount_t
items.description: Total Tax Amount for the Quote.

items.name: _transaction_tax_totalTransactionValueIncTax_t
items.description: Total value of the transaction including all item prices, one-time charges, recurring charges and taxes.

items.name: _transaction_s_isProposalLatest_t
items.description: Indicates whether the proposal document is latest.

items.name: _transaction_s_billToPartyID_t
items.description: The Party ID for the Bill To Customer. This attribute is used when a generalized Party object is used to identify customer parties. The Bill To Party may differ from the CRM Customer, Sold To, and Invoice To Parties.

items.name: _transaction_s_subscriptionNumber_t
items.description: Subscription Number for the draft subscription created during Create Subscription Integration.

items.name: globalDiscountPercent_t
items.description: Specifies the discount percentage to be applied for all line items and its charges in a quote.

items.name: opportunityAmount_t
items.description: The estimated revenue amount from the opportunity.

items.name: opportunityWinProbability_t
items.description: The estimated probability of winning the opportunity.

items.name: _transaction_s_createQuoteAttachment_t
items.description: The file attachment attribute used to attach a document such as Request for Proposal to a quote.

items.name: _transaction_s_bookOrderStatus_t
items.description: Indicates the status of a booked order.
